name: lawful-ui
description: lawful-ui: make your UI obey the law. Tests web and mobile interfaces against 30 Laws of UX and 20 Laws of UI and reports every violation with evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Tests any web or mobile UI against 30 Laws of UX and 20 Laws of UI.
interface.longDescription: When you ask the agent to test a website or app, lawful-ui inventories every component, measures it, checks it against 30 Laws of UX and 20 Laws of UI, and writes a prioritized findings report with evidence and fixes.
